patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Fastmail and GoTo Connect share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Fastmail and GoTo Connect share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Fastmail only if your buying job matches “Privacy-focused business email, calendar and contacts with custom domains and shared addre” rather than GoTo Connect's shape. Choose GoTo Connect only if your buying job matches “Remote-team UCaaS phone system with meetings and messaging — Phone System / CX / Contact C” rather than Fastmail's shape. Workflow advantage: Fastmail leans shared coverage; GoTo Connect leans business-phone, contact-center. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Fastmail and GoTo Connect share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Fastmail is Privacy-focused business email, calendar and contacts with custom domains and shared addresses — Business Basic from $3/user/month annual; a; GoTo Connect is Remote-team UCaaS phone system with meetings and messaging — Phone System / CX / Contact Center ladders are custom-quote (no public seat dol.
- Company-size focus: Fastmail (micro, small-business) vs GoTo Connect (small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Fastmail-leaning — vs GoTo Connect-leaning business-phone, contact-center.
- Researched limits: Fastmail — Not a business phone, WhatsApp or team-chat product — adjacent to business communications; GoTo Connect — No published self-serve seat dollars — every plan is sales-quoted.

Limitations — Fastmail: Not a business phone, WhatsApp or team-chat product — adjacent to business communications; Shared addresses, shared calendars and the shared address book require Standard or above; GoTo Connect: No published self-serve seat dollars — every plan is sales-quoted; Industry dollar ranges are low confidence and must not be treated as list prices.

Poor-fit cases: Fastmail is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a business phone, WhatsApp or team-chat product — adjacent to business communications · GoTo Connect is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No published self-serve seat dollars — every plan is sales-quoted · Avoid Fastmail if you actually need GoTo Connect's motion (Remote-team UCaaS phone system with meetings and messaging — Phone System / CX /)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
